description: Install Epeaky on the server: Docker if it is missing (with Docker's own script), the den and Caddy in /opt/epeaky, a certificate for the domain, and TCP 80/443 and UDP 50000-50199 opened in ufw or firewalld. Run host_check first. Returns the first invite link: show it only to your human, who opens it on their own device. This changes the server: Ask your human first, and tell them what it does. Offer the installer to read first: https://epeaky.zyn-network.com/install.sh

server.description: The server as user@host (its address or name), reachable with your human's SSH key.

name: host_install
